purpose: Prevent Book System from duplicating document-generation, rendering, conversion, validation or artifact-verification machinery that belongs in the reusable Document System while preserving Book System authority over canonical manuscript state, book lifecycle, book-specific publication requirements and publication authorization.

existing_service_boundary.future_provider_binding: DOCUMENT SYSTEM or a Document-System-owned provider implementing the registered interface

book_system_owns: canonical manuscript and exact canonical version identity
book lifecycle stage and export-freeze readiness
book structure, chapters, front matter and author-approved content
selection of requested output formats and target-medium profiles
book-specific publication requirements and acceptance criteria
book-specific metadata semantics and distribution intent
which accessibility and publication standards apply to the requested release
required proof evidence and acceptance/rejection of returned evidence
release rollback and canonical version selection
document_system_owns: EPUB generation, packaging and navigation implementation
artifact digest generation and identity verification
non_duplication_law: Book System MUST NOT implement a second DOCX, PDF, EPUB or print rendering engine.
Book System MUST NOT own generic conversion, accessibility-checking, layout-validation or artifact-digest machinery.
Book System MAY define book-domain requirements, target profiles, acceptance gates and publication semantics consumed by the Document System.
Document System MUST NOT mutate Book canonical state or infer author publication authority from successful generation or validation.
A returned document artifact is evidence/artifact output until Book System explicitly accepts it into the book release state.
If the Document System is not yet implemented, Book System records the required interface and leaves executable document-generation capability pending rather than implementing a local substitute.
qualification_effect: Architecture/ownership boundary only. No Document System runtime, renderer, validator, export artifact or publication authority is created or qualified by this artifact.
